product.name: BenchShare
product.concept: A community-workshop application where members request equipment reservations and coordinators approve them without overlapping confirmed bookings.

visual_direction.world: Public-facility wayfinding translated into a task application: deep blue structure, pale civic surfaces, route colors for status, strong labels, familiar controls, and no decorative card grid.
visual_direction.first_viewport: A persistent route header, equipment lane, reservation timeline/table, and one prominent Request slot action; status is visible as text plus color.
visual_direction.signature_interaction: Selecting an equipment lane narrows available times and keeps the request summary visible; conflicts return inline to the exact field and time range.
visual_direction.motion: 150–200ms state transitions only, disabled under reduced motion.
